Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-PI-001
Rule.Description: Detects direct prompt injection attempts overriding system instructions via user input

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-PI-002
Rule.Description: Detects prompt injection payloads embedded in uploaded files, web pages, or external data sources

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-PI-003
Rule.Description: Detects attempts to extract system prompts through direct questioning, translation, or format manipulation

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-PI-004
Rule.Description: Detects jailbreak attempts using role-play personas like DAN, developer mode, or unrestricted AI

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-PI-005
Rule.Description: Detects few-shot learning manipulation attacks that inject malicious examples into LLM context

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-DEX-001
Rule.Description: Detects LLM outputs containing PII, training data, or confidential information indicating data leakage

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-DEX-002
Rule.Description: Detects attempts to extract training data from LLM through targeted queries and completions

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-DEX-003
Rule.Description: Detects PII (SSN, email, phone, address) leaking through LLM responses

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-MDL-001
Rule.Description: Detects indicators of model poisoning through anomalous training data or unexpected model behavior

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-MDL-002
Rule.Description: Detects potential backdoor triggers in LLM output patterns that indicate compromised models

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-RAG-001
Rule.Description: Detects injection of malicious content into RAG knowledge bases that corrupts retrieval output

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-RAG-002
Rule.Description: Detects adversarial documents in RAG stores designed to manipulate retrieval results

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-HAL-001
Rule.Description: Detects LLM responses containing fabricated URLs, citations, or entity references indicating hallucination

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-HAL-002
Rule.Description: Detects LLM outputs making contradictory factual claims across conversation turns

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-BIA-001
Rule.Description: Detects demographic bias patterns in LLM outputs including gender, racial, or ethnic disparities

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-GOV-001
Rule.Description: Detects AI system operations without documented risk assessment per EU AI Act Article 9

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-GOV-002
Rule.Description: Detects high-risk AI system operations without required human oversight mechanisms per EU AI Act Article 14

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-GOV-003
Rule.Description: Detects AI system operations lacking required transparency disclosures per EU AI Act Article 13

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-RED-001
Rule.Description: Detects adversarial suffix attacks that append optimized suffixes to bypass LLM safety filters

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-RED-002
Rule.Description: Detects token smuggling attacks that use encoding or fragmentation to bypass LLM content filters

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-RED-003
Rule.Description: Detects multi-turn conversations designed to progressively jailbreak an LLM through contextual manipulation

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-SAF-001
Rule.Description: Detects LLM attempts to generate harmful content including weapons, drugs, or dangerous instructions

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-SAF-002
Rule.Description: Detects LLM responses that may facilitate or encourage self-harm behavior

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-VEC-001
Rule.Description: Detects cross-namespace data access in Pinecone vector database

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-VEC-002
Rule.Description: Detects cross-tenant data access in Weaviate vector database

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-VEC-003
Rule.Description: Detects adversarial embedding vectors inserted into ChromaDB collections

Rule.name: FSIEM-AI-VEC-004
Rule.Description: Detects filter injection attacks in Qdrant vector search payloads
